meta_description:
1,621 likes, 6 comments - 47prodoffl on October 17, 2026: "Perform for TKR. Earn the opportunity to learn with KKR. 🏏

Dwayne Bravo explains the pathway he championed as TKR captain: each year, a standout player should be rewarded with the chance to experience a KKR camp in India.

Before LA Knight Riders and Abu Dhabi Knight Riders expanded the family, TKR and KKR were the direct link—and strong performances in the Caribbean could open the door to the global stage.

Should more franchises create opportunities like this for local talent?

🎙️ The Champions Corner with Otis Gibson | Episode 1

#TheChampionsCorner #DwayneBravo #TKR #TrinbagoKnightRiders #KKR #KolkataKnightRiders #CPL #IPL #CaribbeanCricket".
